Repository is on branch main, .git/objects is a REAL directory (not a symlink), fsck clean, 13,367 tracked files, largest 10.3MB. The only way to end-to-end verify GitHub push is USER clicking Save to GitHub in platform UI — do not attempt to push from here.
rca of the issue: RCA (already fixed by main agent before this test iteration): /app/.git/objects was symlinked to /tmp/git-objects-1778088821 (May 6, disk-space workaround). Environment restart wiped /tmp, obliterating the git object database → every git operation errored with 'not a git repository'. Save-to-GitHub, platform auto-commits, and prod deploy snapshotting all silently failed. Mitigation applied: dead symlink removed; real .git/objects directory recreated; stale index/refs/logs cleared; fresh initial commit (eae27c9) of the full 13,367-file / 189MB tree recorded on branch main. Prevention: never symlink .git/objects (or any .git subdir) into /tmp or other volatile mounts.
